# API reference: `pyra.provenance`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_api_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

All names below can be imported from `pyra.provenance`; the most common ones also from `pyra`.

## class `Ledger(path: str | Path)`

Append-only JSON Lines file of artifact records.

* `Ledger.append(self, entry: LedgerEntry) -> bool`
  Append ``entry``. Returns False (and writes nothing) if an identical record exists.
* `Ledger.entries(self) -> list[LedgerEntry]`
  All entries in append order; a bad line raises LedgerCorruptError with its number.
* `Ledger.get(self, artifact_id: str) -> LedgerEntry | None`
  The entry with this artifact id, or None.

## class `LedgerConflictError(...)`

A different record already exists under this artifact id.


## class `LedgerCorruptError(...)`

A ledger line could not be parsed.


## class `LedgerEntry(prov: Provenance, status: Status, unit: str | None = None)`

One ledger line: provenance, status name and unit of an artifact.

* `LedgerEntry.from_dict(d: dict[str, Any]) -> LedgerEntry`
  Inverse of ``to_dict``; raises KeyError or ValueError on malformed input.
* `LedgerEntry.from_quantity(q: Quantity) -> LedgerEntry`
  Entry describing ``q`` (its provenance, status and unit).
* `LedgerEntry.identity_bytes(self) -> bytes`
  Fields that must match for two entries to be 'the same record' (no timestamps).
* `LedgerEntry.to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]`
  JSON-ready dict; the status is stored by name.

## class `LineageCycleError(ids: list[str])`

The recorded parents form a loop (only possible in a forged ledger).


## class `LineageGraph(entries: Iterable[LedgerEntry])`

Parent/child graph over ledger entries, with integrity checks.

* `LineageGraph.ancestors(self, artifact_id: str) -> set[str]`
  Every artifact this one depends on, directly or indirectly.
* `LineageGraph.descendants(self, artifact_id: str) -> set[str]`
  Every artifact that depends on this one, directly or indirectly.
* `LineageGraph.from_ledger(ledger: Ledger) -> LineageGraph`
  Build the graph from every entry in ``ledger``.
* `LineageGraph.parents(self, artifact_id: str) -> tuple[str, ...]`
  Direct parent ids of an artifact (KeyError if the id is unknown).
* `LineageGraph.topological_order(self) -> list[str]`
  Parents before children, ties in ledger order. Raises LineageCycleError on a loop.
* `LineageGraph.verify(self) -> list[LineageIssue]`
  Integrity problems found in the graph; an empty list means none were found.

## class `LineageIssue(kind: str, artifact_id: str, detail: str)`

One problem found by ``LineageGraph.verify``.


## class `Provenance(artifact_id: str, parents: tuple[str, ...], activity: str, params: dict[str, Any], source_ref: str | None, code_version: str, env_hash: str, created_utc: str)`

Where an artifact came from: parents, activity, parameters, source and environment.

* `Provenance.from_dict(d: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Provenance`
  Inverse of ``to_dict``; raises KeyError if a field is missing.
* `Provenance.to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]`
  Plain-dict form used by the ledger.

## class `Quantity(value: Any, unit: str, u: Any | None, u_kind: str, status: Status, prov: Provenance)`

A value with a unit, an uncertainty, an epistemic status and its provenance.

Build one with ``Quantity.measured``, ``Quantity.scenario`` or ``Quantity.derive``; direct
construction is for deserialization. Quantities are immutable.

* `Quantity.derive(value: Any, unit: str, u: Any | None, u_kind: str, *, parents: Sequence[Quantity], activity: str, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, method_status: Status = Status.DERIVED, max_input_status: Status | None = None, source_ref: str | None = None, code_version: str = 'unknown', env_hash: str = 'unknown', created_utc: str | None = None) -> Quantity`
  A value computed from other quantities.
* `Quantity.expected_id(self) -> str`
  The artifact id this content should have, recomputed from the current fields.
* `Quantity.measured(value: Any, unit: str, u: Any | None, u_kind: str, *, source_ref: str, activity: str = 'read', params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, code_version: str = 'unknown', env_hash: str = 'unknown', created_utc: str | None = None) -> Quantity`
  A value read from a source file or channel. Requires a source reference.
* `Quantity.scenario(value: Any, unit: str, u: Any | None, u_kind: str, *, activity: str, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, source_ref: str | None = None, code_version: str = 'unknown', env_hash: str = 'unknown', created_utc: str | None = None) -> Quantity`
  User-specified or hypothetical conditions (status SCENARIO).
* `Quantity.verify(self) -> bool`
  True if the stored artifact id matches the current content (detects tampering).

## class `Status(*values)`

Epistemic status, ordered by distance from direct observation (higher = weaker).


## class `StatusError(...)`

A status rule was violated.


## class `StatusInputError(...)`

An input has a higher status than the method accepts.


## `canonical_bytes(obj: Any) -> bytes`

Canonical JSON bytes of ``obj`` (ASCII, sorted keys, compact separators).

## `enforce_max_input_status(inputs: Iterable[Status], max_allowed: Status, method: str) -> None`

Raise StatusInputError if any input is above ``max_allowed`` (call-time method guard).

## `join(*statuses: Status) -> Status`

Status of a result: never more certain than the weakest input.

## `sha256_hex(obj: Any) -> str`

SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical bytes of ``obj``.
